actions.delete_rows.description: Deletes every row where a column equals a value.
The column to match rows on.
actions.delete_rows.props.search_value.d: Rows whose search column equals this value are deleted.
actions.find_rows.description: Finds rows where a column equals a value.
actions.find_rows.props.search_column.de: Leave empty to read rows without a filter.
actions.find_rows.props.search_value.des: Rows whose search column equals this value are returned.
actions.insert_rows.description: Inserts one or more rows into a table.
actions.run_query.props.args.description: Values for $1, $2 and so on in the query, in order.
actions.run_query.props.markdown.descrip: Never type dynamic values into the query. Write $1, $2 and put the values in Arguments to prevent SQL injection.
actions.run_query.props.query.descriptio: One SQL statement. Write $1, $2 where each value goes.
actions.update_rows.description: Updates every row where a column equals a value.
The column to match rows on.
actions.update_rows.props.search_value.d: Rows whose search column equals this value are updated.
actions.update_rows.props.values.descrip: Only the fields you fill are changed.
description: Fully managed cloud data warehouse from AWS.
triggers.new_or_updated_row.description: Triggers when a row is added or its timestamp column changes.
triggers.new_or_updated_row.props.timest: A timestamp column your loads set on every insert and update, like updated_at. Read as UTC.
triggers.new_row.description: Triggers when a new row is added to a table.
triggers.new_row.props.order_by.descript: A unique column that grows with every new row, ideally an auto-increment id. Rows that share a value with an earlier row, or that commit after a row with a higher value, can be missed, so avoid timestamps.
